3. (1) Subject to the provisions of any written law, the
general objects for which the body corporate is constituted
are to :
(a) Conduct  educational  and  skills  development
programmes to better equip youth to meet the needs
of job opportunities of the future and acheive their
goals ;

(b) Establish  a 
traning  Centre 
for 
Information
Technology (IT) - related services ;

(c)
Provide  and/or  arrange  Information  Technology
(IT) - related services for the youth in rural areas ;
(d) Conduct all such programmes as needed from time
to time to enchance skills and learning ;
(2) In the implementation of the objectives specified
in  subsection  (1)  body  corporate  shall  ensure  that  such
implementation will be carried out without any distinction
based  on  race,  religion,  language,  caste,  gender,  political
opinion, place of birth or such other ground.
